title: Herbal Ethiopian Chewy Herbs Gored-Gored
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with puff pastry, herbs, and spices. Quick to make and suitable for a no-onion-no-garlic diet.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
In a mortar and pestle, pound the cilantro, parsley, and dill until coarsely chopped.
Mix the ground ginger and cumin into the herb mixture.
Spread the herb mixture evenly over the puff pastry, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling to form a border.
Cut the pastry into 8 equal pieces.
Place the pastry pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
